1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.e5 Nd5 4.Nc3 e6 5.Nx.strategy: Strikes at once at Black's pawn centre: the pawn attacks c5 and backs up e5, so the white centre is firm. White opens the game while Black's pieces are still at home, and play becomes sharp.
Develops with pressure on both d4 and e5, so the centre is tested at once while the pawns on c5 and d5 stay in place. The result is a sharp struggle, in which White tends to keep the better chances.
1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.e5 Nd5 4.Nc3 e6 5.Nx.name: Sicilian Defence: Nimzowitsch Variation, Main Line
